$description: DHCW Single Record Design System — Logo sizing tokens. Three-tier model: Global (raw pixel values) → Alias (semantic intent) → Component (applied to Logo component). Height is the controlled dimension; width always scales proportionally. Sync source: Figma variable collections 'Primitives' (global tier) and 'Single Record' (alias + component tiers).

logo.$description: Global logo sizing scale. Raw pixel values, no semantic meaning. Lives in the Primitives variable collection in Figma.

xs.$description: Absolute minimum. Reserved for compact icon-only usage in dense UI.

sm.$description: Small — icon in compact placement, full logo in footers.

md.$description: Standard — default for both icon and full logo in primary UI.

xl.$description: Extra large — hero areas and splash screens.

2xl.$description: Maximum — print, marketing, and full-bleed digital layouts.

icon.$description: Alias tokens for the icon logo variant (square, 1:1 aspect ratio). Maps semantic intent to global values. Lives in the Single Record variable collection in Figma.

default.$description: Icon in standard UI contexts: headers, navigation, app chrome. → 32px

compact.$description: Icon in dense UI: breadcrumbs, chips, inline context labels. → 24px

prominent.$description: Icon in hero areas and authentication screens. → 48px

full.$description: Alias tokens for the full lockup logo variant (horizontal, aspect ratio varies per brand). Height controls scale; width is proportional. Lives in the Single Record variable collection in Figma.

default.$description: Full lockup in page headers and primary placement. → 48px

compact.$description: Full lockup in footers and secondary placement. → 32px

prominent.$description: Full lockup in splash screens, print, and marketing. → 64px

logo.$description: Component-level tokens applied directly to the Logos component in Figma and consumed by platform implementations. Lives in the Single Record variable collection in Figma.

size.$description: Controls the height (and equal width) of all Logos component icon variants (Type=Icon). Default: 32px. Override at instance level by referencing a different Size/Logo/Icon/* alias token.

height.$description: Controls the height of all Logos component full lockup variants (Type=Full). Width scales proportionally per brand aspect ratio. Default: 48px. Override at instance level by referencing a different Size/Logo/Full/* alias token.
